name: refused-gpio-second-pad-word
description: Refusal sample: two pad groups naming two different readable pad words on one device. The bound gpio.pins endpoint exposes one pad word, so the executor refuses the second group by name instead of folding it onto the first.
notes: this scenario exists to record the named refusal, not to pass

configs/behaviors/declaration-only/gpio_two_pad_words_groups_f5.json states groups at PADIN(8) and PADOUT(12); the declaration layer normalizes both, and the executor refuses the differing pad word with unsupported-pins:pin_groups:second-pad-word
